steps: Lie on a flat bench with both feet planted, grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders, and brace your torso.
Keep your shoulder blades stable as the bar moves down under control toward your chest.
Press the bar upward with control while keeping your wrists above your elbows.
Lower with control for the next repetition; use the rack and appropriate assistance when finishing.

steps: Set the bar across your upper back and stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart. Brace your torso.
Bend your hips and knees together, keeping your feet planted and your back stable.
Lower to a depth you can control without losing your back position.
Push through your feet and extend your hips and knees to stand again.
Fit a straight bar to a high cable pulley and stand facing it with a stable stance.
Hold the bar with an overhand grip and keep your upper arms close to your sides.
Straighten your elbows to press the bar downward without moving your torso or upper arms.
Bend your elbows under control to return the bar to the starting position, then repeat.
